content.text:
**Migration report**

Two features were tried, and neither found signal.

The first was a temporal standardization of the V03 flow rate against each group's own expanding history. It produced a mildly negative average rank correlation with next-month returns (t about -1.4). Coverage was only 71%. It had moderate overlap with base features and little regime difference by T. This suggests V03 momentum is not rewarded, and may weakly reverse.

The second was a relative three-month change comparison between V02 and V04. It scored essentially zero (t about 0.05) and showed no T-regime dependence, which failed my stated hypothesis.

Next I would try level or persistence-based features on V01, V05 and V06, and would avoid long-history standardization because of its coverage cost.
